κρήνην: κρήνη — spring, fountain; fem. acc. sg.

μῆχος: μῆχος — means, remedy, way out; neut. nom./acc. sg.
νεαροὶ: νεαρός — young, youthful; masc. nom. pl.: ’young ones’

πόνος: πόνος — toil, labour, hardship; masc. nom. sg.

σιωπᾶν: σιωπάω — be silent; pres. inf., after ἀνώγει: ’to be silent’

φόνον: φόνος — murder, slaughter, bloodshed; masc. acc. sg.
φύλοις: φῦλον — tribe, race; neut. dat. pl.: ’tribes’
φῦλα: φῦλον — tribe, race; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’tribes’
χειμέριαι: χειμέριος — wintry, stormy; fem. nom. pl., agreeing with ἄελλαι
χθιζά: χθιζά — yesterday; adv. (neut. pl. of χθιζός ’of yesterday’)
χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a time’
χῆραί: χῆρος, χήρα — bereft, widowed; fem. nom. pl.: ’widowed’ (accent from the following enclitic)
ψεῦδος: ψεῦδος — falsehood, lie; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’a falsehood’
ἀγλαὸν: ἀγλαός — splendid, bright, radiant; neut. nom./acc. sg.

ἄελλαι: ἄελλα — storm, blast of wind; fem. nom. pl.

ἄνεῳ: ἄνεως — silent, speechless; masc. nom. pl.

ἄργεος: Ἄργος — Argos; neut. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)

ὅου: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc./neut. gen. sg., epic ὅου (= Attic οὗ): ’whose’
ὑπέσταν: ὑφίστημι — undertake, promise; aor. 3 pl. intrans., epic ὑπέσταν (= Attic ὑπέστησαν): ’they undertook’
ὑπαΐξας: ὑπαΐσσω — dart out from under; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’darting out from beneath’
ὑπερμενέα: ὑπερμενής — of surpassing strength; masc. acc. sg., epic -έα (= Attic -ῆ), agreeing with Κρονίωνα
ὑποπεπτηῶτες: ὑποπτήσσω — crouch beneath, cower; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic ὑποπεπτηῶτες (perf. πεπτηώς): ’crouching beneath’
ὠκυπόροισιν: ὠκύπορος — swift-faring (of ships); fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)

__broaden__.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl. as the plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῶν ’on them’) · also gen. pl. dependent on a noun, ’of them’ (ἄνυσις … αὐτῶν ’accomplishment of them’)
__broaden__.κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’
__broaden__.οἷς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’his own’ · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. dat. pl.: ’to whom’ (οἷς … μέλει ’to whom … is a care’)
__broaden__.πολὺν: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’a great host’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with χρόνον: ’a long (time)’
__broaden__.νῶτα: νῶτον — back; neut. acc. pl., poetic ’the broad back of the sea’ · also acc. pl. of respect, ’on the back’ (ἐπὶ νῶτα δαφοινός ’blood-red on the back’)
__broaden__.τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’)
__broaden__.ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
__broaden__.εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’)
__broaden__.ἧς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; fem. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (ἧς εἵνεκα ’for whose sake’) · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with its noun (ἧς ἀλόχοιο ’his own wife’)
__broaden__.ᾗς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., agreeing with ὑπεροπλίῃσι · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗς (= ᾗσι, Attic αἷς): ’in which’ (ᾗς ἐπέπιθμεν ’in which we trusted’)
__broaden__.ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
__broaden__.ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’)
__broaden__.ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’)
__broaden__.περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’)
__broaden__.ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’
__broaden__.ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — hither, to this place; adv. of motion · also ’here, in this place’ (ἐνθάδε μιμνόντεσσι ’for those who stay here’)
__broaden__.φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear’ · also neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’own’ (φίλα εἵματα ’his own clothes’) · also neut. acc. pl., ’dear’ (φίλα τέκνα ’dear children’)
__broaden__.δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
__broaden__.τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’)
__broaden__.ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’)
__broaden__.ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’)
